title: Distilling Aggregate Mobility Statistics into a Language Model Policy for Post-Event Crowd Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pedestrian simulators need a behaviour rule for every agent, but privacy usually limits the data for setting one to aggregate statistics, namely zone-level device counts and origin-to-destination (OD) flows, with no individual trajectories. Such aggregates under-determine individual behaviour, because many different sets of decisions reproduce the same counts. We fine-tune a language model crowd agent so that the simulated population matches the observed destination composition, the fraction of the departing crowd heading to each point of interest. We read this target from the OD flow and reweight the model's own destination distribution onto it by iterative proportional fitting. Because fine-tuning inflates the dominant destination class, we fit the low-rank adapter to trajectories resampled to a corrected training composition that reaches the target after this inflation. translated_title: 将聚合移动统计量蒸馏为事件后人群模拟的语言模型策略
translated_abstract: 行人模拟器需要为每个智能体设定行为规则，但隐私通常限制用于设定规则的数据仅为聚合统计量，即区域级设备计数和起点到终点（OD）流量，且没有个体轨迹。此类聚合数据无法唯一确定个体行为，因为许多不同的决策集合可以复现相同的计数。我们微调一个语言模型人群智能体，使模拟人群与观测到的目的地构成（即离开人群前往每个兴趣点的比例）相匹配。我们从OD流量中读取这一目标，并通过迭代比例拟合将模型自身的目的地分布重新加权到该目标上。由于微调会膨胀主导目的地类别，我们将低秩适配器拟合到重采样后的轨迹上，这些轨迹采用修正的训练构成，在膨胀后能达到目标。在来自两场棒球比赛的移动网络计数上，微调后的模型...
tldr: 本文提出利用语言模型微调，仅基于聚合移动统计（区域计数和OD流量）生成事件后人群模拟，通过迭代比例拟合和重采样修正训练构成，使模拟人群的目的地分布与观测一致。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes fine-tuning a language model for post-event crowd simulation using only aggregate mobility statistics, aligning simulated destination distributions with observed data via iterative proportional fitting and resampled training composition.
